description: This file defines the ProjectListener class, which listens and responds to various project-related events such as creation, publishing, and readiness. It handles tasks like sending notifications, logging activities, and updating feeds associated with project events.

classes.name: ProjectListener
classes.description: Listener class for handling project-related events, such as creation, publishing, and readiness. It manages notifications, feed logging, and other side effects triggered by project lifecycle events.

methods.name: logFeedEntry
methods.description: Logs a feed entry, indicating whether it's a duplicate or a new entry.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Sends notification messages to specified targets (owner, consultants) for a project, ensuring no duplicate events are created.

methods.name: onProjectCreated
methods.description: Handles the event when a project is created; sends notification and logs activity.

methods.name: onProjectPublish
methods.description: Handles project publishing; logs activity, sends notifications, and updates feeds.

methods.name: onProjectReady
methods.description: Handles marking a project as ready; sends review requests and logs activity.

methods.name: getSubscribedEvents
methods.description: Returns an array mapping event types to handler methods for event subscription.
